label: Run Action Hook
description: Runs a ThunderPHP action hook exactly where this node is rendered in the View.

properties.name: hook_name
properties.label: Hook name
properties.help: The public action hook name registered by other plugins with add_action().

properties.name: component_name
properties.label: Reusable component name
properties.help: Leave blank to render at this node's position. Set a name while the node is a View root to place it with <tvi-component name="..." />.
